summary.text: Miguel García, listed by Ballotpedia as Miguel Garcia, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 14 who took office in 1997 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
García's professional experience includes working as a Spanish teacher in the Albuquerque Public Schools system.

paragraphs.text: García earned a B.A. from Eastern New Mexico University, Portales, in 1973 and an M.A. from the University of New Mexico, Albuquerque, in 1993.
In the 2025-2026 session, García serves on the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee and the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
In 2021-2022, García chaired the Local Government, Land Grants & Cultural Affairs Committee.
